name: Shinjou Maria
source:
Main anchor of a news program for which the main character is the director. She is mainly in charge of news about incidents and accidents.

She is a talented woman who was selected as the main anchor in her second year with the company. She is currently the No. 1 married anchor because of her cheerful, friendly, and gentle personality.

She went to an all-girls' school in college and university, so although she has little sexual experience, she is not a virgin.

[From [url=https://gyutto.com/i/item1768?select_uaflag=1]Gyutto[/url]]
